question: Does Parpola 2019 decide the H-938/H-939/H-1284/H-2145 side/sign mapping, or only add reverse-side pressure?
result: Parpola 2019 adds a prior-work reverse-side clue for H-938/H-939/H-1284/H-2145 and a separate sign no. 41 control clue for H-940/H-2147/H-2148. It does not decide local row-to-side mapping, numeric sign crosswalk, sign value, or translation.
unchanged_blocks: No Parpola-to-local numeric crosswalk is accepted.
No sign value or translation is accepted.
